title: Jets camp day 3 observations
body: Hall was limited in team drills again after tweaking something in his hamstring on Monday. Allen took the majority of first-team reps in his place and looked comfortable in pass protection. Davis handled third down work. Wilson did not practice and the staff called it a rest day.

title: Practice notes: backfield picture
body: Another day where Hall was limited, which is now two straight. Allen continues to see the bulk of first-team snaps.
